record.paper: Every planar graph with $Δ\geqslant 8$ is totally $(Δ+2)$-choosable

dossier_meta.paper: Every planar graph with $Δ\geqslant 8$ is totally $(Δ+2)$-choosable
dossier_meta.context_text: This is the list coloring analogue of the Total Coloring Conjecture (Conjecture 4), asserting that the list total chromatic number never exceeds $\Delta + 2$. It is stated without a bibliographic citation in the paper, appearing as a natural companion to Conjecture 4. The paper's main result (Corollary 1) proves Conjecture 5 for all planar graphs with $\Delta \geq 8$.
